I wrote `component.html` in the folder: the "New request" screen at 1280px inside `#component`, in static HTML and CSS with no JavaScript. I haven't opened it in a browser, so I haven't checked how it looks.

It has the "New request" heading, a Title text input, a Description textarea, Priority and Assignee selects with your options, a Due date input, and the "Cancel" and "Create Request" buttons. Priority, Assignee and Due date sit in one row.

It follows `DESIGN.md`:
- **Layout and colors:** it uses the listed palette, type sizes and 12-column grid, with the form card spanning 8 columns.
- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo are named first, but there are no font files in the folder. Without them installed, the page falls back to the system sans-serif.
- **Heading case:** the heading is all caps through CSS, so the HTML text still reads "New request".

The other files in the folder were `prompt.txt` (this same request), `session.json` (empty) and `session.err`, which holds only an "unrecognized model" log line.
